Bold leadership for a new affordability agenda by @RepCasar & CPC!


Congressman Greg Casar (@RepCasar)

Today we are announcing the Progressive Caucus’ New Affordability Agenda.

Donald Trump lied about bringing down costs.

We need an actual plan to make things cheaper by taking on corporations ripping people off.

Under this plan, every American family saves money. Here's how -->



— https://nitter.net/RepCasar/status/2049459168176656471#m

Not enough, but more than Trump has ever done.


Manu Raju (@mkraju)

No explicit mention of Epstein survivors from Charles, though he said “support victims of some of the ills that, so tragically, exist in both our societies today”

Ro Khanna said today: “The British ambassador has suggested that the king will acknowledge the Epstein survivors”



— https://nitter.net/mkraju/status/2049213147106464129#m

Political violence has no place in a democracy. Instead of partisan finger points, here are concrete ways we can address it without censoring speech. We can disagree without demonizing each other.

Video

I co-introduced historic legislation to increase the minimum wage to $25.

As someone who taught economics at Stanford, here is why it makes sense.

The real minimum wage was $14 in 1968. 

Today it is half, but productivity has increased 2.5x.

Instead of extractive capitalism, we need a free enterprise system that pays workers what they are worth.

Video

King Charles declined my request for him to meet with survivors. He should, at least, recognize their courage in his speech today.


Ali Vitali (@alivitali)

New w/ @lilliebnews: It’s not that King Charles’ visit to the nation’s capital on the 250th anniversary of America’s independence isn’t important. It’s just that, to Rep. Ro Khanna, justice for the survivors of Epstein’s abuse should matter just as much.
 ms.now/news/ro-khanna-crusad…



— https://nitter.net/alivitali/status/204918118341462

.@claireforny understands that we need moral foreign policy that rejects military interventionism and upholds human rights.

We need a good neighbor policy towards Latin America, an end to the fuel blockade in Cuba, an end to the occupation of Palestine, & an end to war in Iran.


Claire Valdez (@claireforny)

For decades, we've been sold the lie that empire advances freedom and keeps us safe. Instead, it's led to violence, instability and a ruling class that reaps the profits but never pays

.@GovRonDeSantis if you are going to invoke the abused of the Epstein class in an ad, will you call for the release of the files as required by @RepThomasMassie & my law (3 million covered up) & for prosecutions? 

Agree we need well crafted regulations to protect kids from AI algorithms.


Ron DeSantis (@GovRonDeSantis)

Now is the time for choosing. Florida legislators have the chance to protect children and families against Big Tech corporations that are experimenting on kids and teenagers wi

Virginia Giuffre’s family is bringing together survivors calling for the release of the 3 million Epstein files still being covered up.

I get texts from survivors every day ask why there are no investigations and prosecutions of men who abused them?

Video

No Super Pacs in Democratic primaries. Not in 26. Not in 28.


Bernie Sanders (@BernieSanders)

AIPAC, AI & crypto are undermining democracy as they plan to spend over $500M in 2026.

While we fight to overturn Citizens United, Democrats must get their own house in order and ban super PACs in their primaries.

One person one vote. Billionaires should not buy elections.





— https://nitter.net/BernieSanders/status/2048859509402046600#m

I agree we should not demonize Americans who voted for Trump. Do you agree not to demonize those who voted for Harris or Sanders? I am for Team America.


Gunther Eagleman™ (@GuntherEagleman)

Ro Khanna says political violence is “out of hand” and affecting “both parties.”

Bro, there have been three assassination attempts on President Trump, and you’re still doing the “both sides” dance while blaming social media and mental health?

You want to talk about “early intervention”? Start by telling

I am deeply sorry for your loss. It is deeply tragic that Katie was killed by an intoxicated driver, and I cannot even fathom the pain. I would welcome a conversation if you or your family are open to it.


Joe Abraham (@angeldadjoe)

I promise you, Ro Khanna, my daughter was scared when she was forced to take her last breath. 
I was not there to hold her as she slipped away.
For years, Americans were told about “robust vetting” and “screening.” My family learned the cost of those false assuranc

Sharing your reproductive health journey with the world is a demonstration of the character and courage it takes to be a leader. 

Families all across the country face these heartbreaking experiences, and people like Amy and Graham light the way for countless others.


Graham Platner for Senate (@grahamformaine)







— https://nitter.net/grahamformaine/status/2048896128645488772#m
